title: 'The Wreckers' Roost' ('east along the shore from the quay, past the dunes') took 15+ turns of undirected wandering through a maze of similarly-flavored coastal rooms (Kelp Line, Samphire Bank, Reed Cut, The Widow Rocks, Low Marsh) before the entrance appeared — the bearing hint didn't meaningfully narrow the search.
